storyCards.fact:
Hole's "Doll Parts" reached #58 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Doll Parts" is a song by American alternative rock band Hole, written by vocalist and rhythm guitarist Courtney Love.

The song peaked at #58 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Doll Parts was released in 1995.
